name: Cowboy Caviar
author: Chris Crawley
steps: Drain and rinse the black-eyed peas and black beans.
Drain the corn. Drain and chop the olives.
Seed and finely chop the jalapeños, onion, and bell peppers. Chop the avocados.
Combine all ingredients except avocados in a large bowl and toss to combine.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour (or overnight for better flavor) to allow the ingredients to marinate in the dressing.
Add the avocados just before serving and toss to combine. Makes 2 generous quarts. Best served with tortilla chips.
